outcomes.title: Government Investment and Accountable Delivery
outcomes.desc: Ensure governments commit the funding, services, protections and coordinated action needed to meet community needs, with measurable targets, clear responsibilities and accountability for delivery.

outcomes.title: Right to Remain and Return
outcomes.desc: Protect residents and local businesses from displacement, ensure affordable and meaningful opportunities to remain or return, and address harms caused by past displacement.

outcomes.title: Community Wealth and Inclusive Local Economies
outcomes.desc: Expand community ownership of land and spaces, protect local businesses, create decent jobs, and ensure residents benefit equitably from neighbourhood investment and economic growth.

outcomes.title: Community Decision-Making and Reparative Justice
outcomes.desc: Give residents and community organizations meaningful, resourced authority over planning and implementation decisions, while providing remedies for harms caused by past government actions.

outcomes.title: Human Rights, Anti-Racism and Accessibility
outcomes.desc: Confront systemic racism, ageism and ableism through human rights-based planning, removing barriers to accessible housing, community services, economic opportunities and culturally appropriate participation.

aggregation: each completed response contributes once; provisional averages available from first completion
explicitChoice: Ten highest topics are suggested from ranked themes and outcomes; participants can pin other topics to the highest ten, automatically displacing the lowest-ranked unpinned suggestion, and can move any highest topic to the middle, replacing it with the next eligible suggestion; participants select four lowest from the middle, leaving nineteen in the middle.
